name: slider
title: Slider
description: Pick a number or a range from a continuous track — horizontal or vertical, any number of thumbs, each with a 24px invisible hit area (A11Y-2).

meta.whenToUse: An imprecise value over a bounded range — volume, brightness, a price filter.
meta.whenNotToUse: Exact values or large/open ranges (number input); on/off (Switch).
